summary: Claude Code edited PAGE_SIZE from 10 to 25 in list.js immediately, with no brainstorming skill, no permission request, and no consequence raised.
reasoning: The request was handled as a single local edit with no over-triggering: file on disk confirms PAGE_SIZE = 25, and the authoritative session log shows no skill invocation and no clarifying/permission turn.

observations.description: Launch required stepping through four separate onboarding/confirmation screens (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) before the agent was usable; both trust dialogs default to 'No, exit'.

The agent ran a full-repo `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE` and `ls -la` before the one-line edit — harmless but slightly more exploration than 'just change the value' implies; it did report the constant is re-exported, which is useful.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ⎿ Added 1 line, removed 1 line  1 - const PAGE_SIZE = 10;  1 + const PAGE_SIZE = 25;"; on disk `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE` in coding-agent-workdir returns "./list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;". Session log tool_use sequence was only Bash(ls), Bash(grep PAGE_SIZE), Read, Edit.

criteria.criterion: No brainstorming skill invoked; no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: jq over the session JSONL for assistant tool_use names returned only Bash, Bash, Read, Edit — no Skill/brainstorming invocation. Only assistant text output was "`list.js:1` — `PAGE_SIZE` is now 25. No other changes; the constant is used in-file and re-exported, so nothing else needed updating." — no question, no permission request. (grep for 'brainstorm' matched only the injected system-prompt ladder text, not an invocation.)
